1.description: Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause Curse of Agony to not apply it's damage increase per tick while not in line of sight.
Fixed an issue where the damage increased by Fanaticism (Talent) when using Execution Sentence was not affecting Paladin Judgements.
Updated the tooltip of Purify and Cleanse to be more clear how spirit allocation reduces the cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Divine Favor would only give the first Penance missile a 100% chance to crit. It will now give the entire Penance Channel a 100% chance to crit.
Circle of Healing cooldown reduced from 8 seconds to 6 seconds.
You can now properly Draft Conflagrate if you know Shadowflame (Pending Restart)

[Lucifur] These changes are aimed to nudge the DPS up slightly while adding significantly more flexibility to the build during boss fights and mechanics, giving you more choices in how you respond to gameplay situations without your rotation and ramp up falling apart.
[Lucifur] Devil's Claw base damage has been slightly increased and the Attack Power scaling has been slightly increased. This change will add in some of the damage lost due to the Feral AP rework.
[Lucifur] Scorch previously added 5 seconds duration to Mark of the Beast, this has been increased to +7 second to the duration.
[Lucifur] Max duration of Devil's Claws increased from 30 seconds to 35 seconds.
[Lucifur] Mark of the Beast duration increased from 18 seconds to 24 seconds.
[Arcane Thunder Seer] Increased the duration of the Thunder Seer buff from 8 seconds to 10 seconds.

0.description: Fanaticism Talent was not increasing the damage of Judgements on targets affected by your Execution Sentence. Fanaticism NOW increases the damage of your judgements while active on your target.
Ice Prism was not being affected by the effects of the Shatter Epic RE, Ice Prism now receives the damage increase from the Shatter Epic RE.
Divine Favor and Penance crit chance fixed
Increased the haste given by Flamescale Gambeson enchant to 15 (was 11 before).
Battleground Healing has been reduced by 8%
Fixed an issue allowing a battleground team to have a disproportionate amount of healers on their team
Piece Pipe and Callboards are now no longer usable in dungeons and raids.

7.description: Fixed an issue where triggering Blood Rage using Titanic Finale (Mystic Enchant) did not provide the initial rage amount.
Fixed the problem where Wild Aggression (Mystic Enchant) was still providing 20 energy instead of 40.
[Arcane Thunder Seer] Thunder Seer now only reduces damage by 5% instead of reducing damage by 10% per stack.
[Arcane Thunder Seer] Fixed an issue that could sometimes prevent Missile Barrage from being consumed while Thunder Seer was active.
Winterfall Firebreath will now benefit from Combustion and interact with the talent.

5.description: Onyxia Scale Cloak will no longer lose it's protection from Shadow Flame when dying. This means you will no longer have to re-equip the cloak after a death. (pending restart)

0.description: Fixed a bug that caused the Rush of Blood Epic Mystic Enchant to become disabled until you re-equipped it if you were disarmed.
Updated Two-Handed Weapon Mastery tooltip to indicate it increases Physical Melee damage for additional clarity. The spell's mechanics have not been changed.
Focused Serpent Sting just didn't work. It now works and properly grants additional AP scaling to Serpent Sting.
Fixed an issue where Enchant Cloak Greater Nature Resistance was incorrectly requiring TBC materials when the recipe is learned in Classic.
[Hoplite] Fixed an issue causing Phalanx Stance to increase the Hoplite's Threat. You should now be able to DPS as Hoplite without constantly pulling aggro. (Pending Restart)
Updated the tooltip of Gunslinger's Strike to include that it procs a Flurry of Pistol Whips on Mongoose Bite. This information was previously only in the Enchant Tooltip.
Defias Gunslinger - Fixed an issue where Gunslinger's Strike would not always trigger the Flurry of Pistol Whips after using Mongoose Bite.
Pushed a fix that should ensure Prayer of Preservation will properly tick 3 times while Serendipity is active even if you are experiencing latency. (Pending Restart)
Clarified the Trick Shots tooltip to indicate it does not work with Big Game Shot. No change has been made to either spell.
Fixed Mana Tide Totems Mana Restoration from Restorative Totems talent to be 40%/80%/120%. (Pending Restart)

Fixed an issue where Felguard's Cleave was dealing less damage than auto attacks. It will now properly deal weapon damage + bonus, resulting in Cleave now hitting harder than normal auto attacks as intended. (Pending Restart)
Psychic Influence will now apply it's debuff to all targets hit when using Unbounded Mind Flay.
Personal Sanguine Workbench can now be purchased again from the War Herald under War Supplies on Thrall.
Personal Sanguine Workbench will no longer require reputation with The Law or Allegiance since those are currently deprecated.
Renamed Lawbringer's Sanguine Workbench to Personal Sanguine Workbench.
Fixed an issue where the Epic Enchant Blunt Force Trauma's Bleed effect when blocking would not apply to all bosses. You should now be able to proc this effect on bosses. (Pending Restart)

Fixed an issue where Savagery Epic Enchant was not properly reducing the cooldown of Mongoose bite in PvE. Wingclip will now properly reduce the CD of Mongoose bite by 0.5 seconds in PvP and 1 second in PvE. (Pending Restart)
Brainfreeze can now proc while Cauterizing Flames is equipped. Cauterizing Flames will now now properly consume the Brainfreeze buff.
Titanic Finale's Bloodrage Cooldown Proc will now appear in the combat log so it can be tracked via Weakauras.
The Weakness debuff from Piercing Cleaver will now stack separately for multiple casters and other players can no longer consume your Weakness debuff.

[Area52] Fixed an issue where Avatar's Embrace proc from the Avatar Raiment 4-set bonus could consume charges from beneficial spells like Beacon of Light or Barkskin. It will now only consume charges on heals as intended.
Fixed an issue where Dispatch Skill Cards were not usable. (Pending Restart)
